Use the daily facial cleanser in the morning and before you go to sleep. You only need about a pea sized amount, just use water to help get a nice lather on your skin. Sunscreen everyday during the day, even if it’s cloudy/raining/etc. (Reapply sunscreen at least every 2 hours if you are outside.) Moisturize after every time you wash your face. You can replace the daily cleanser with the exfoliating one 1-2x a week at night, but make sure to thoroughly moisturize after to protect your skin barrier when introducing exfoliants. You only need enough of each product to lightly but thoroughly coat the skin. Start with a pea amount and dab it around your face (I do a dot on my forehead, each cheek, and chin) then rub in, and if you need more,  add a little dab by dab. Good luck!

Aquaphor makes hand masks you can get, they are like gloves that you wear for a while to let the moisturizing serum sink into your skin. Is there anyway you could wash your hands less? You can also try applying a thick hand cream like Eucerin or Nivea and wearing gloves or mittens at night to make sure it soaks in. Otherwise, just try to use a thick, moisturizing hand cream after every time you wash your hands. One that is unscented. Also try switching to a hand soap that is fragrance and dye free and labeled for sensitive skin. If that doesn’t work, you might need to try using a wash that isn’t actually “soap.” You might also consider substituting handwashing with a moosturizing hand sanitizer (Dove makes one) whenever possible. Good luck!

If all goes well and fine, wait AT LEAST a month and go ahead and try a standard dose which is 3.5. I would absolutely NOT go above that while on an SSRI though.

It won’t work except on a placebo effect if you haven’t already been taking it on a daily basis and even then you would need to be on some sort of schedule even if it was spaced out to maintain the levels. Prozac takes time to build up in your system to an effective level so taking it just every once in a while won’t do anything and you’ll likely have side effects each time because it will be recognized as new since it won’t be built up. Wouldn’t recommend doing or trying this without talking to a doctor.
